name: Cross-architecture layer sweep + static probe (R1-32B & QwQ-32B)
description: Full 64-layer sweep on R1-32B and QwQ-32B. Extract hidden states at all layers, evaluate static LR probes under multiple selection metrics. Discovers layer selection bias (bal_acc × crossing_rate → shallow layers).

tables.name: Layer Selection Metric × Model → Selected Layer

analysis:
Layer sweep结果本身不变，但AdvBench非复现将C1从'general finding applicable to any hidden-state evaluation'降级为'task-specific observation about temporal monitoring pipelines using crossing_rate statistics'。Reviewer: 'If the bias is specific to crossing_rate in temporal settings, then it's a footnote in your methods section, not a standalone contribution. Rename the section from "Layer Selection Sensitivity" to "Implementation Note: Crossing Rate Bias."'


Layer sweep在CP数据上发现genuine methodological pattern（biased metric selects shallow layers），corrected layers确实show HS advantage。这些结果不受AdvBench 非复现影响——它们是关于CP temporal data的发现。但worst-tier reviewer将AdvBench 非复现与此联系：'你在CP data上发现的layer selection bias是CP annotation structure 特有的——crossing_rate在temporal monitoring中有意义，但这不是general model property。既然bias只在temporal setting中存在，那C1的scope就是一个pipeline-specific caveat，不是methodological contribution。任何使用不同task structure的研究者 不会遇到这个问题。'

name: Cross-architecture temporal window evaluation (32B)
description: Temporal LR at multiple window sizes on R1-32B (L63) and QwQ-32B (L60). Validates temporal context improvement on 32B models.

tables.name: Temporal Window Effect on 32B HS Probes (corrected layers)

analysis:
R1-32B dimensionality问题（51200×W > n=20）使W>1结果不可靠。QwQ flat。 Temporal benefit主要是text probe finding。AdvBench非复现进一步说明：即使temporal probing pipeline在CP data上work，其关键组件（crossing_rate, layer selection） 都是task-specific的。


Temporal context对text probes universally有效，对HS probes在2/4模型上有caveats （OT-7B saturates at W=3, R1-32B degrades with W>1 due to dimensionality）。 Worst-tier下AdvBench非复现不直接影响这个实验的数据，但强化了reviewer的论点： 'temporal monitoring pipeline本身就充满了model-specific hyperparameters（layer, W, K）。你在每个model上需要tuning这些参数，AdvBench上bias又不复现——这说明你的 整个方法论都是dataset-specific的。'

name: Cross-model transfer probes
description: Train probe on one model, test on another. PCA projection for cross-architecture transfer. Tests universality of safety commitment encoding.
analysis:
Complete transfer failure combined with AdvBench non-replication paints a picture of extreme specificity. Everything is model-specific AND task-specific. Reviewer: 'The paper's implicit promise of generalizable insights is contradicted by its own evidence.'


Cross-model transfer完全失败。最佳transfer accuracy 67.3%远低于within-model performance，cross-family（Llama↔Qwen）接近chance。AdvBench非复现与此一致： 如果连layer selection bias都是task-specific的，那safety encoding的model-specificity 更是预期的。Worst-tier reviewer: 'Transfer failure + AdvBench非复现 = 你的 所有findings都是dataset×model specific的。没有任何generalizable component。 这篇paper的external validity接近零。'

name: Lead time analysis across models
description: HS probe lead time distributions on all 4 models. Compare HS vs text lead times.

tables.name: Lead Time: HS vs Text vs Position

analysis:
Lead time是practical dealbreaker。AdvBench非复现加强了reviewer的generalizability concern: '所有timing结论都只在这一个CP-annotated dataset上成立。'


Lead time在4个模型上表现分裂：R1-8B HS lead≈0（at commitment, not before）， QwQ HS lead为负（text检测更早），R1-32B HS lead positive但coverage仅25%， OT-7B lead inflated by long traces。AdvBench非复现不直接改变lead time数据， 但reviewer论证chain strengthened: '既然layer selection bias是task-specific的， 那lead time结果也可能是task-specific的——你在不同benchmark上可能得到完全不同的 timing profile。没有cross-dataset validation证明timing findings的robustness。'

name: TrajGuard-style Mahalanobis baseline (4 models)
description: Mahalanobis distance on safe-trace covariance across all 4 models. Tests geometric distance-based detection.
analysis:
Universal Mahalanobis failure supports 'existing methods fail' narrative。 但这个negative result是predictable的，reviewer不计入contribution。


Mahalanobis在4/4模型上失败（max separation 0.20, FA≥TP at all thresholds）。 Signal在minor PCA components中——Mahalanobis structurally blind to this geometry。 此negative result与AdvBench无关（Mahalanobis不依赖crossing_rate或CP structure）， 但worst-tier reviewer仍然dismiss: 'Mahalanobis failure是predictable—— safety-relevant features orthogonal to principal variance是known phenomenon。 Testing one known-limited baseline is due diligence, not contribution。'

name: Bootstrap CI + threshold-independent metrics
description: 10000 bootstrap resamples on key metrics across 4 models. Holm-Bonferroni correction. AUROC, PR curves, detection delay CDF.
analysis:
Statistical significance established on CP data. AdvBench非复现的影响不在 于推翻这些p-values，而在于质疑其generalizability: '在AdvBench上HS-text gap 仅+2-3pp (NS)。如果换个dataset significance就消失，这说明12/12 HB是dataset- specific的，不是modality-inherent advantage。'


12/12 HB pass在CP data上是statistically clean的。这些结果不受AdvBench非复现 影响——statistical significance是关于CP temporal data的。但worst-tier reviewer 攻击practical significance和multiplicity: (1) 'per-model best layer AND best window选择后再test，true multiplicity远超12个corrected tests'; (2) '32B model CIs极宽（R1-32B ±15pp），statistical significance with n=20只说明 effect large，不说明estimate precise'; (3) AdvBench非复现加了一层：'你的 statistical machinery只在这一个dataset上验证过。12/12 HB on one dataset ≠ robust finding。'

name: Window size ablation (W=1,3,5,10,15,20,25)
description: Systematic window sweep on all 4 models. Characterize precision-coverage tradeoff.
analysis:
No operating point achieves deployment-ready precision AND coverage simultaneously. AdvBench context reinforces: these tradeoffs may not even transfer to other datasets.


Precision-coverage tradeoff universal but no operating point achieves deployment-ready performance。Worst-tier reviewer: 'Coverage monotonically decreases with W是detection criterion K的数学性质，不是insight。 Optimal W varies by model = another model-specific hyperparameter。 Combined with AdvBench layer bias非复现，整个pipeline的generalizability story 进一步弱化——每个model×dataset组合需要独立tuning。'

name: Layer selection ablation (5 metrics × 4 models)
description: All-layer temporal probes on 32B models with 5 selection metrics. Core experiment for C1 layer selection bias claim.

tables.name: Layer Selection Bias: CP Data vs AdvBench (R1-8B)

analysis:
这是worst-tier的defining result。CP data上16-layer gap vs AdvBench上2-layer gap直接证明bias是crossing_rate temporal structure产物。Paper must explicitly acknowledge: 'Layer selection bias is specific to temporal monitoring pipelines using crossing_rate-based metrics. Binary classification tasks do not exhibit this bias.' C1 scope收窄但不删除——仍然是valid methodological finding within its scope.


Layer selection ablation在CP data上reveals genuine pattern。但这是worst-tier的 核心实验——AdvBench非复现直接打击这个实验的generalizability claim。在CP data上， crossing_rate在shallow layers系统性偏高是因为temporal probe score序列中，shallow层 probes更noisy→更频繁crossing threshold→crossing_rate虚高→与bal_acc相乘后拉向 shallow layers。在AdvBench binary classification中，没有'连续probe score序列的 threshold crossing'概念——每个trace只有一个binary prediction，crossing_rate要么 不存在（无temporal sequence）要么在所有层similar（无differential noise结构）。 所以bias不复现是MECHANISTICALLY CONSISTENT——不是实验失败，而是bias的root cause 在AdvBench中不存在。Worst-tier reviewer nonetheless argues: 'Consistent non- replication means the bias is a pipeline artifact, not a model property. Your C1 contribution scope is now: "if you use crossing_rate as part of your layer selection metric in a temporal monitoring pipeline, be aware it biases toward shallow layers." That's a methods note, not a contribution.'

name: 16-label taxonomy supervision
description: Fine-grained safety labels (Type 1/2/3/4 × pre/post) instead of binary commitment. Evaluate richer supervision impact.
analysis:
Fine-grained supervision dead-end. Linear probes saturated at binary level. AdvBench adds: even the binary signal is task-specific.


Fine-grained labels提供marginal improvement（+0.6-1.1pp collapse后）。 16-class accuracy低（26-41%）因为transition types在hidden-state space中 不cleanly separable。AdvBench非复现不直接影响此实验，但reviewer argument strengthened: 'Binary labels work almost as well as 16-label supervision. And on AdvBench (also binary), the whole pipeline fails to distinguish HS from text. This suggests the signal structure you're exploiting is extremely narrow — it exists only in CP-annotated temporal data with step-level labels.'

name: Oracle decomposition
description: Analyze oracle label sequence vs hidden-state probe predictions. Explain 31-step gap between oracle and probe lead time on R1-8B.

results.pattern: Labels show gradual erosion; hidden states show step-function at CP

tables.name: Oracle vs Best Probe Lead Time

analysis:
Hidden states are reactive, not predictive. Combined with AdvBench showing no HS-text differentiation, worst-tier reviewer concludes: 'This paper convincingly demonstrates that hidden-state monitoring is fundamentally limited. The contribution is negative — which is fine for a Findings paper, but not sufficient for Main.'


Oracle gap reveals hidden states encode current safety state but not trajectory toward commitment。Labels显示gradual pre-CP patterns（increasing unsafe-adjacent labels, shortening safe streaks），hidden states不track这些 patterns。AdvBench非复现reinforces this: 'Hidden states don't capture safety trajectory even on the dataset specifically designed to test this. On a different dataset (AdvBench), the signal degrades further. The fundamental limitation is that hidden states are snapshots, not trajectory predictors.'

name: OpenThinker-7B (Qwen2.5-7B, STILL-trained)
description: 4th model completing 2×2 architecture×scale matrix. Full pipeline: layer sweep, temporal probes, bootstrap, selectivity.
analysis:
OT-7B strengthens 7-8B story on CP data but is irrelevant to AdvBench non-replication concern. Worst-tier: '4 models on 1 dataset ≠ 1 model on 4 datasets.'


OT-7B是single-model最clean evidence（3/3 HB, highest selectivity 18.3pp, largest n=228）。但这在CP data上的strong result并不帮助AdvBench non-replication： 'A 4th model confirming the same CP-data pattern doesn't address the cross- dataset non-replication. You have 4 models × 1 dataset = 4 data points on the same distribution. AdvBench shows the pattern doesn't transfer to a different distribution. More models on the same dataset is width without depth of validation.' OT-7B HS temporal saturation at W=3也says something: even on the best model, the temporal signal is fragile.

name: GRU/Attention probe upper bound (32B)
description: GRU on 32B models at corrected layers. Tests nonlinear sequence modeling vs linear temporal probes.
analysis:
Linear probes at information ceiling. Complexity doesn't help. Combined with AdvBench showing no HS advantage at all, the message is: 'The signal is both simple and narrow.'


GRU不优于temporal LR on 3/4 models（R1-32B -6pp, QwQ -3.7pp due to overfitting on small samples）。Linear probes sufficient。Worst-tier reviewer: 'Method is logistic regression with sliding window — the simplest possible baseline. GRU/MLP failure confirms method space is trivial. On AdvBench binary data, even this trivial method can't differentiate HS from text. The information ceiling is low across the board.'

name: Text-based baseline (sentence embeddings + temporal LR)
description: Sentence-BERT (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) + temporal window LR on CoT text. Critical HS vs text comparison.

tables.name: HS vs Text: CP Data vs AdvBench

analysis:
Text baseline comparison reveals the HS advantage is task-specific. On temporal CP detection: HS clearly better. On binary AdvBench: HS ≈ text. This is the strongest evidence that the findings don't generalize beyond the specific pipeline.


Text baseline在CP data上consistently underperforms HS by 15-24pp precision， 但在AdvBench binary task上这个gap shrinks to +2-3pp (NS)。Worst-tier reviewer uses this asymmetry: 'On the one dataset where HS advantage matters (CP temporal), yes HS wins. But you showed on AdvBench that the advantage vanishes. The HS advantage is not a modality property — it's a task×modality interaction. For the specific task of temporal safety commitment detection with step-level labels, HS helps. For binary safety classification, it doesn't. This means the 15-24pp gap is not about "hidden states are better monitors" — it's about "hidden states help with THIS specific task."' Additionally: BGE-large comparison (1/4 HB pass) shows gap narrows with better text encoder. A reviewer asks: 'What about GPT-4 as text classifier? The gap likely closes to <5pp.'

name: BOCPD/CUSUM on all 4 models
description: BOCPD + CUSUM on probe score sequences across 4 models. Tests advanced change-point methods for lead time improvement.
analysis:
BOCPD/CUSUM negative result is predictable. Method selection too narrow. Combined with AdvBench non-replication, entire negative result portfolio is dismissed as 'testing wrong tools on a narrow task.'


BOCPD在3/4模型上0% detection——OT-7B probe scores too spiky，32B models signal太weak。只有R1-8B有gradual transitions compatible with Gaussian change-point model。CUSUM universally worse than simple FCP threshold。 AdvBench非复现不直接影响BOCPD结果（BOCPD operates on temporal probe scores， AdvBench是binary task没有temporal scores），但strengthens the 'nothing transfers' narrative: '你测试了2个off-the-shelf change-point methods，都失败。 你的layer selection bias也不generalize。你的HS advantage也不generalize。 整篇paper的主题是"on one specific dataset with one specific pipeline, one specific finding holds."'

name: False positive analysis (safe traces, all methods)
description: All probes on safe traces across 4 models. Safe FPR, pre-CP FPR, precision-recall curves.
analysis:
FPR is the deployment dealbreaker on CP data. AdvBench non-replication closes the escape hatch of 'maybe it works better on other datasets' — it demonstrably works WORSE. Reviewer verdict: 'A monitor that fires on 1/3 safe traces is noise. Adding AdvBench shows this isn't fixable by changing the dataset.'


Safe FPR 11-52%，median约39%。这意味着每2-3个safe traces就有1个false alarm。 No operating point achieves simultaneous >70% precision AND >60% coverage on ANY model。QwQ HS safe FPR (45-50%) actually HIGHER than text (33-43%)。 AdvBench非复现加重了practical concern: '在你优化过的CP dataset上，safe FPR 已经是39%。在AdvBench上HS甚至不优于text。任何real-world deployment都会面临 distribution shift，FPR只会更差。这个系统在production中是不可用的。'

name: AdvBench Layer Bias Replication (R1-8B)
description: Replicate layer selection bias on AdvBench using R1-8B with binary jailbreak/safe labels. Train probes at all 32 layers, run 5-metric layer selection analysis. Tests whether crossing_rate bias is model-geometric (general) or CP-annotation-specific (task-bound).

tables.name: CP Data vs AdvBench: Layer Selection Bias Comparison
AdvBench Crossing Rate by Depth Band

analysis:
AdvBench非复现是worst-tier的defining experiment。结论分为两个component:
(1) Layer selection bias非复现：Mechanistically consistent。crossing_rate bias 的root cause是temporal probe score序列中shallow layers的noise-driven threshold crossings。Binary classification不产生这种temporal structure。Bias不复现 不invalidate CP data上的finding——it BOUNDS its scope。C1调整为: 'Layer selection bias is a pitfall specific to temporal monitoring pipelines that use threshold-crossing statistics for layer selection. It does not manifest in standard binary classification settings.'
(2) HS-text gap非复现：+3pp (NS) vs CP data +22.4pp (HB ✅)。HS advantage 在binary classification上消失，说明advantage来自temporal structure interaction（hidden states track step-level state transitions that text embeddings miss），而非inherent modality superiority。
Paper impact: C1 scope从'any hidden-state evaluation should audit layer selection metrics'收窄到'temporal monitoring pipelines using crossing_rate should audit layer selection'。这让contribution更precise但less impactful。
Reviewer split: - Supportive (R1): 'Boundary condition analysis is good science. Showing WHERE
  your finding applies and where it doesn't is a sign of mature methodology.
  The AdvBench non-replication actually STRENGTHENS the mechanistic argument —
  you can explain WHY it doesn't replicate (no temporal structure → no
  crossing_rate bias).'
- Dismissive (R2): 'The non-replication means your headline finding (layer
  selection bias) is a pipeline implementation detail, not a scientific
  contribution. You could fix it by not using crossing_rate — which any
  careful practitioner would do anyway. The AdvBench experiment cost 6 GPU
  hours to show your contribution is smaller than claimed.'

Dream score delta: -0.10 (3.0 → 2.9). Non-replication doesn't kill the paper but removes the possibility of C1 earning generalizability points. Paper stays at Findings level; no pathway to Main opened by this experiment.

AdvBench非复现的root cause是mechanistic的，不是statistical noise:
(1) crossing_rate在binary classification中不产生浅层虚高。在CP temporal data中， crossing_rate measures how often probe score crosses threshold DURING a trace。 Shallow layers的probes更noisy（cosine distance smaller, representations more compressed）→更频繁crossing→crossing_rate虚高→与bal_acc相乘后bias toward shallow layers。在AdvBench binary classification中，虽然可以对每个token计算probe score 并观察序列，但binary labels（jailbreak/safe per trace）不创造step-level temporal structure。Probe scores在entire trace上趋于一致（consistently jailbreak或consistently safe），所以crossing_rate在所有层上都很低（~0.11-0.12）， shallow/deep ratio≈1.05，无显著差异。
(2) HS-text gap在binary classification中collapse到+3pp (NS)。原因：hidden states 对CP temporal task的advantage来自于tracking step-level safety state transitions—— hidden states可以detect commitment point前后的internal representation shift。 Binary classification不需要这种temporal sensitivity——只需要区分'this trace as a whole is jailbreak vs safe'。对于这个coarser task，text embeddings capture足够 的signal（jailbreak traces有distinctive vocabulary/structure），HS的marginal advantage消失。
(3) Layer selection convergence: 5个metrics全部选中层（L12-L14, 39-45% depth）， gap仅2层。这是因为binary classification的optimal layer由overall representation quality决定（middle layers best balance between too-raw和too-output-specific）， 而非threshold-crossing-dynamics。所有metrics agree on similar layers because they're all measuring the same underlying discriminability without temporal confounds。
(4) Traces太uniform: AdvBench prompts + R1-8B responses产生相对homogeneous的 traces——jailbreak traces consistently harmful, safe traces consistently refuse。 没有CP temporal data中的'safety reasoning followed by commitment'渐进结构。 所有层表现接近（bal_acc range across layers: 0.55-0.65），metric间无显著分化。
